reviews.text: I've been using Furry Friends for nearly 3 years now for daily walks for my golden retriever. The service has been 100% reliable, with great communication and flexibility but,  most importantly, the love and care all of the team show the dogs is reassuring as you know you're leaving your dog in safe hands. I love to see the photos from the walks on Facebook as it gives you a glimpse into the fun the dogs have together on the walks and why Betty comes back so shattered and sleeps for the rest of the afternoon.  I couldn't recommend the service or the team members more.  Definitely 5 stars and a big thank you from us!
